title: Final Warnings and Greetings

questions.question: Paul says this is the third time he is coming to them. Every charge must be established by the evidence of two or three ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 13:1 (ESV): "This is the third time I am coming to you. Every charge must be established by the evidence of two or three witnesses."

questions.question: He warns them that if he comes again he will not ____ them.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 13:2 (ESV): "I warned those who sinned before and all the others, and I warn them now while absent, as I did when present on my second visit, that if I come again I will not spare them—"

questions.question: Since you seek proof that Christ is speaking in me. He is not weak in dealing with you, but is ____ among you.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 13:3 (ESV): "since you seek proof that Christ is speaking in me. He is not weak in dealing with you, but is powerful among you."

questions.question: For he was crucified in ____, but lives by the power of God.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 13:4 (ESV): "For he was crucified in weakness, but lives by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but in dealing with you we will live with him by the power of God."

questions.question: Examine yourselves, to see whether you are in the faith. ____ yourselves.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 13:5 (ESV): "Examine yourselves, to see whether you are in the faith. Test yourselves. Or do you not realize this about yourselves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you fail to meet the test!"

questions.question: Or do you not realize this about yourselves, that Jesus Christ is ____ you?—unless indeed you fail to meet the test!
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 13:5 (ESV): "...Or do you not realize this about yourselves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you fail to meet the test!"

questions.question: But we pray to God that you may not do ____—not that we may appear to have met the test, but that you may do what is right, though we may seem to have failed.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 13:7 (ESV): "But we pray to God that you may not do wrong—not that we may appear to have met the test, but that you may do what is right, though we may seem to have failed."

questions.question: For we cannot do anything against the truth, but only ____ the truth.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 13:8 (ESV): "For we cannot do anything against the truth, but only for the truth."

questions.question: For we are glad when we are weak and you are strong. Your ____ is what we pray for.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 13:9 (ESV): "For we are glad when we are weak and you are strong. Your restoration is what we pray for."

questions.question: Paul writes these things while away so that when he comes he may not have to be severe in his use of the authority that the Lord gave him for ____ and not for tearing down.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 13:10 (ESV): "For this reason I write these things while I am away from you, that when I come I may not have to be severe in my use of the authority that the Lord has given me for building up and not for tearing down."

questions.question: Finally, brothers, rejoice. Aim for restoration, comfort one another, agree with one another, live in ____;
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 13:11 (ESV): "Finally, brothers, rejoice. Aim for restoration, comfort one another, agree with one another, live in peace; and the God of love and peace will be with you."

questions.question: ...and the God of ____ and peace will be with you.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 13:11 (ESV): "...and the God of love and peace will be with you."

questions.question: Greet one another with a holy ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 13:12 (ESV): "Greet one another with a holy kiss."

questions.question: All the ____ greet you.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 13:13 (ESV): "All the saints greet you." (Note: some Bibles have this as verse 12 or 13 depending on numbering, ESV has it as verse 13).

questions.question: What is the famous trinitarian benediction that ends 2 Corinthians? "The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ and the love of God and the fellowship of the ____ be with you all."
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 13:14 (ESV): "The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ and the love of God and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all."

key_verse_text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ and the love of God and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.
